# Amberley Haulage - gate log

One row for each day the yard gates were open, with the crates that left. The log runs
from 24 September to 5 October because the September claim is written after the
month has closed.

turns.prompt: Amberley Haulage is closing the September gate figures. How many crates went out in the week of 28 September?
The whole week, through to the Sunday. Give the number alone, as digits, with no label. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
